candidate: For the ext-filesystem v7 runtime using large-DATA async dispatch, request four bounded and four unbounded kernel workers per NUMA node. This dedicated ring issues only WAL DATA writes. Unsupported/denied tuning keeps kernel defaults; other runtimes retain their setup.
motivation: The first bounded-only prototype passes its ring setter/query test but observes231 helpers in the engine. Pinned Linux6.12.71 code queues forced-async requests before file assignment; such WRITE requests can be classified into the unbounded pool. Limit both classes and require an actual engine probe before scoring.
scope: One source candidate; local repo only. Validate and run a bounded SSD screen, dependent guards only after screen benefit. Preserve prior evidence; stop for review, no push/PR.
validation: Real ring test verifies ordinary setup preserves limits, candidate setup sets both classes to four, and mixed large/small O_DIRECT writes complete exactly. Existing v7 recovery, extent, poison and ownership coverage plus full checks outside sandbox. A fixed unscored16-writer engine probe must observe at most eight helpers before the scored matrix starts.
configuration: Fresh local ext4 databases, 1KiB values, 2GiB SST, explicit v7 Parallel/no compaction. 750000 batch64 puts/sample10 at16,8,1writers;100000 point puts/sample100 at8writers. Host audit before/1Hz/after,30s initial cooldown,10s gaps, no concurrent build/test/source edit/profile.
schedule: Two warmups and five alternating pairs at batch16, followed by two warmups and three alternating pairs each at batch8,point8,batch1. Run all four fixed cells regardless of interim performance to preserve smaller-workload evidence under moving stalls. No replacement or score-selected retries; stop on capture correctness or sampled host-audit errors.
stall_policy: Preserve every raw invocation. Predeclare an obvious-stall flag when mean FRONTIER-write >=1ms or mean fdatasync >=1.5ms, relative to observed quiet markers~20-150us and syncs~350us. Exclude a pair from the filtered comparison if either invocation is flagged. This conservative aggregate mask misses short outliers and cannot prove retained samples stall-free or distinguish source-induced I/O changes from environment. Report exclusions by arm and all raw ratios.
assessment: Screen: at least3 filtered matched pairs with median paired and arm-median throughput>1 and paired p99<1. Other cells: at least2 filtered pairs with paired and arm-median throughput>=0.95 and paired p99<=1.10. Identical DATA bytes throughout. CPU/RSS diagnostic only. All four cells are captured even if a guard fails; aggregate threshold limitations remain explicit. Retention requires the complete assessment or a clearly labelled maintainer-directed provisional decision.
publication: Keep accepted source in its own local commit, with evidence separate. For a failed or inconclusive candidate, evidence-only commit plus exact restoration.
candidate_probe: One fixed excluded16-writer engine probe after release build. At most eight sampled helpers on this one-NUMA-node host is a prerequisite for scoring. No source/build/test overlaps probe or matrix.
